flows.name: Serverless web API
flows.explain: DNS sends visitors to the edge, which forwards API calls to API Gateway. API Gateway invokes a function, and the function reads and writes a table.

flows.name: Static website
flows.explain: A website's files live in an S3 bucket, and CloudFront caches them close to visitors.

flows.name: Signed-in API
flows.explain: Users sign in with Cognito; API Gateway checks their token before calling the backend.

flows.name: Event-driven upload processing
flows.explain: Once EventBridge is turned on for the bucket, each new object raises an event. A rule routes it to a function that queues follow-up work.

flows.name: Data lake analytics
flows.explain: Glue catalogues the files in S3 so Athena can query them with SQL where they lie.

flows.name: Generative AI app
flows.explain: An API calls a function that asks a foundation model on Bedrock and returns the answer.

flows.name: Container service
flows.explain: DNS points at a load balancer that spreads requests across the tasks of an ECS service on Fargate. The tasks keep their data in a managed RDS database.

flows.name: Agentic microservice
flows.explain: An API passes the request to an agent on AgentCore Runtime. The agent asks a model on Bedrock what to do, then calls its tools through AgentCore Gateway: a Lambda function that reads and writes a table.

flows.name: App Runner with a private database
flows.explain: An App Runner service reaches an RDS database in private subnets through a VPC connector.

flows.name: App Runner to ECS Express Mode
flows.explain: Route 53 weighted records shift visitors step by step from App Runner to an ECS Express Mode service on Fargate.

flows.name: Batch job on upload
flows.explain: An object uploaded to S3 matches an EventBridge rule, which submits an AWS Batch job with the bucket and key as parameters.

flows.name: Lightsail website
flows.explain: An A record in Route 53 points the domain at a Lightsail instance's static IP address.

flows.name: Central backups
flows.explain: One AWS Backup plan backs up tagged tables, file systems and volumes into an encrypted backup vault on a schedule.

flows.name: Real-time stream
flows.explain: Producers write records to a Kinesis stream; Lambda reads each shard's records in order and updates a DynamoDB table.

flows.name: Stream archive
flows.explain: A stream's data delivery writes its raw records to an S3 bucket for archive, replay and later analysis.

flows.name: Searchable catalogue
flows.explain: An OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline copies a table's items into OpenSearch and follows DynamoDB Streams, so every item can be searched by any word.

flows.name: Log search
flows.explain: CloudWatch Logs streams log data to OpenSearch Service, where it can be searched and charted.

flows.name: React to document changes
flows.explain: A Lambda function reads a DocumentDB change stream and runs each time data in the cluster changes.

flows.name: Network hub
flows.explain: Each VPC attaches once to a transit gateway, which routes traffic between VPCs and to on-premises networks.

flows.name: Global front door
flows.explain: Users connect to an accelerator's static IP addresses at the nearest edge location, and it carries them over the AWS network to healthy load balancers or EC2 instances.

flows.name: Database login from a secret
flows.explain: A function fetches the database login from Secrets Manager when it runs, then connects to RDS. Secrets Manager rotates the password in both places.

flows.name: Security findings to one board
flows.explain: GuardDuty, Inspector and Macie send their findings to Security Hub, which correlates and ranks them and passes them to EventBridge for automated responses.

flows.name: Long text to speech
flows.explain: A function starts a Polly speech synthesis task for a long text; Polly saves the audio file to an S3 bucket and can notify an SNS topic.

flows.name: Text insights from uploads
flows.explain: Text files land in S3, a function asks Comprehend for the sentiment, entities and personal data in each, and saves the results.

flows.name: Order workflow with undo steps
flows.explain: An API starts a workflow. Step Functions runs each function in order, retries short glitches and runs undo steps if one fails; each step records its work in a table.

flows.name: Servers with no open doors
flows.explain: Session Manager opens a shell on a server through its SSM Agent, with no inbound ports, and logs the session to CloudWatch Logs.

flows.name: Spot and fix a broken setting
flows.explain: Config records a change to a bucket, a rule finds it breaks the rules, and a Systems Manager Automation runbook puts the setting right.

flows.name: Same baseline in every account
flows.explain: A new account joins an OU, a StackSet deploys the baseline stack to it, and its CloudTrail trail sends logs to a central bucket.

flows.name: Live updates over GraphQL
flows.explain: A signed-in user sends a mutation, a resolver saves it in DynamoDB, and AppSync pushes the change to every subscribed app.
